svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for EdTech product design. Piles of books rise as a staircase, one book higher each step, toward a graduation cap on the top pile. A learner stands on the second step and reaches up for the next one, a lime book. Beside the stairs stands a blue phone showing a lesson: a video, a course progress bar with two of four steps done, and a lime next-step button. A dashed line runs from that button to the lime book, so the next step in the app is the next step up for the learner.
